articles.title: Experts divided over Binance hack asset freezes, warn recovery is another matter
articles.snippet: Tether, Circle and others moved within hours to block billions in stolen crypto, but legal experts question whether smaller victims would get the same protection.

articles.title: Crypto liquidations jump to $1.57 billion as Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether lower
articles.snippet: Bitcoin traded near $77,350 after $6.3 billion Binance hack, with crypto futures liquidations jumping to $1.57 billion.

articles.title: Strategy CFO Andrew Kang resigns as company posts record operating profit
articles.snippet: Andrew Kang’s departure comes as Strategy reports $21 billion in quarterly operating income and bitcoin holdings of 848,517 BTC.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls below $77,000 as Binance exploit combines with tech woes
articles.snippet: The $6.3 billion Binance hack added to crypto jitters, while weak earnings outlooks and mounting concerns over AI spending pushed the Nasdaq down more than 2%.

articles.title: Binance hack bites India's largest crypto exchange as it curbs futures trading
articles.snippet: CoinDCX has restricted new futures positions after Binance’s security incident disrupted a key liquidity provider. Deposits, withdrawals and customer funds remain unaffected, the exchange said.
